findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) If used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours. 

Multiple food contact items on the drying/storage rack across from the three part sink were observed soiled with remaining food debris. Per the PIC this area is intended for cleaned item storage. The PIC was shown the items and moved them back to the sinks for re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are fully cleaned in the facility.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

The mop sink faucet appears to be leaking at the time of the inspection. The PIC was shown and instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all plumbing fixtures are maintained in good repair at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

At the time of this inspection there is not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) available at the facility. Food handling and preparation activities are taking place. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to have enough CFPMs available to cover all shifts at the facility. Three to four CFPMs are suggested at the minimum.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

Two corners of the metal steamer in front of the walk in cooler’s side door have duck tape observed wrapped around the upper corners. Tape is generally not considered to have an easily cleanable surface. The location was shown and discussed with the PIC. Repairs to the equipment to remove the sharp edges was discussed. It is suggested to at least change out the tape for hard plastic corner covers that can be easily wiped and/or cleaned. This situation should be remedied prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces in and around moisture and food preparation are maintained in good repair and also in a smooth and easily cleanable state.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

Observed multiple employees to change gloves without washing hands. Another employee was observed to enter the kitchen and don gloves without washing hands. Times requiring hand washing were reiterated with the PIC and they are instructed to ensure that hand washing took place at all applicable times in the facility.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed a utensil being stored in the cream cheese, in the walk-in cooler. Ensure that, when a product is not in use, the utensil is either removed and placed into dish, or stored in a manner that does not allow the handle to contact the food.  Utensil was removed and the manager disposed of the remainder of the cream cheese. 
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the facility to have turned off one of their hand sinks due to it leaking from the faucet when not in use. The flow of the water is steady, however, the next available hand sink is on the other side of the building. Turning off this hand sink causes there to only be 1 available hand sink in the entire kitchen area. Ensure that, even though there is a leak at the faucet, the sink is left on during business hours to promote proper hand washing by all employees. Hand sink was turned back on during the inspection. Manager stated there had been a work order in for 3 days at the time of the inspection. 
750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

Ensure that all floors in coving are maintained in good repair with a smooth, easily cleanable surface, as well as in a clean state.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed soy sauce mixtures in the large prep cooler to be at internal temperatures of 62F. These mixtures consist of base sauce, vinegar, sugar, water and orange extract (alcohol, water, oil of orange). Since this mixture is mixed on site, it is considered a potentially hazardous product as manager does not have any information to show otherwise at this time. While the ingredients individually are shelf stable, the any mixtures made on site are considered PHF unless food safety testing is provided. Manager will work on getting this information to inspector. In the meantime, these mixtures were moved to the walk in cooler to be held until unit is repaired.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 A spatula being used to aide in the scrapping of soiled dishes is observed shoved between the back of the three compartment sink and the wall. Spatula is soiled and the act of storing this scrapping tool between the wall and sink is removing the caulking and causing food debris to drip down the wall behind the sink. Practice ceased during inspection. Store scrapping tool on the sideboard on the overhead shelf. Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Observed single-service spoons at the drive-thru window to be stored handle to face and vice versa. During the inspection, the spoons were properly stored with the handle present out for grabbing. Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: 750-820 The hot water heater is broken. Hot water is not available. Facility is boiling water for the 3-compartment sink and for handwashing. Repair request was submitted on Friday, checked unit and approved maintenance today, and a new water heater is going to be installed tomorrow. For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing utensils and equipment, each compartment of the sink shall be supplied with hot and cold potable running water.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 The three compartment sink is not properly caulked to the wall. See violation #24. Properly caulk the sink to the wall to keep food and water from dripping behind the sink. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: Rice in hot cabinet is 128F. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above) Rice was voluntarily discarded.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Edge of top of prep table has area has a gap. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Seal this gap.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1100(b) Drain lines from equipment shall not discharge waste water in such a manner as will permit the flooding of floors or the flowing of water across working or walking areas or into difficult-to-clean areas, or otherwise create a nuisance. The drain line from the ice machine at drive through is dripping. According to the manager, a plumber came in to fix the line.  However when I checked, the line was still leaking. Repair the drain line so that it does not leak.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: The drain line form the ice bin at drive through is leaking.750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code. Repair drain line.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: There are no Illinois Certified Food Service Sanitation Managers at this facility. 750-540 All Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of  Licensed Food Service Sanitation Managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of  Food Service Sanitation Managers

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. The ice machine in back has some soil on the drop guard. This ice is not used for food. Clean and keep clean.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. The single use utensils are stored with eating and handle ends mixed in the area by the  inside cash register. Face utensils so that they are protected.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: .140 bottom 2 pans of rice in warmer were at 120-133 degrees F.  Rice was discarded.  Note - top pans of rice were at 150 F.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: .280) peas and carrots scoop found stored hanging outside the food.  Store any in-use utensils in the food with the handle out.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: .800) drip guard of ice machine has mold. Pot sticker bowl on line was soiled and sitting out.  Clean and sanitize these items.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: .800) faucet handle and backsplash of wok grill are greasy.  Handles to large prep cooler have food build-up.  Bottom of inside of small prep cooler has food debris. Lower shelf at 3 c/ompartment sink is soiled.  Shelves of small storage cabinet across from steam table is are dirty.  Pipes under wok grill are greasy.  Inside of fryer panels have grease build up.  Dustpan is soiled with food build up.  Clean these areas.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: .1060) wok faucet is dripping when turned off.  Repair leak.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: .1200) and .1220) floor drain by drive thru soda machine is dirty.  Floor under cooking equipment is dirty.  Drain cover is off at mopsink.  Clean these floor areas and reattach mopsink drain cover.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: .540) there is no certified food handler present.  Each shift must have an IL Food Service Sanitation Certified Manager present.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text: 750.280 - A) Ice scoop was observed with handle down touching ice in the ice machine. B) Metal pan holding ice scoop by drive thru window was sticky. Store scoops in foods with handles extended up out of the product. If containers are used to hold ice scoops make sure they have been properly cleaned. Scoop for ice machine was placed in the ice with the handle extended up out of the ice. The sticky pan was taken to the dish area to be cleaned and the ice scoop in the drive thru was placed in a clean pan.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d - (R) Restrooms do not have covered waste cans. Both restrooms have metal garbage cans (imbedded in the wall), but a small covered waste can is required for items such as dirty diapers. Provided covered waste cans in both restrooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 - (R) Floor drains by drive thru (under soda machine & counter/steam table) were missing covers down inside the drains. Provide covers for the floor drains in question and any other drains where covers may be missing.
